[4:17PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

There is slow movement descending from CMS Bridge towards Offin Canal Market, caused by high vehicular volume, active market operations, and frequent in-and-out traffic at the market. However, traffic clears up after Offin Canal Market, with smooth flow from that stretch through to Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection.

Broad Street down to Apongbon, including the section beneath the bridge connecting to Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, is experiencing steady movement, although slightly impacted by the evening rush and market activity.

Eko Bridge inbound Apongbon towards CMS is moving well.

Traffic is also flowing freely from Idumota Bridge descending toward Ebute-Ero and Leventis, through UBA Roundabout, connecting both Inner and Outer Marina.

At the moment, there are no major obstructions, and our personnel are actively managing traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA
